g.text: An agent loops: plan, act with a tool, observe, decide
it stops on success, a limit, or a handoff to a person
workflow: the developer fixes the steps in code
the LLM fills in each step; cheaper, predictable
agent: the model decides the next step itself
use it only when the path cannot be known
per-step accuracy compounds: 0.95 over five steps = 77%
at 0.90 per step, five steps succeed about 59%
